defects.summary: `CodexRuntime.QuotaKeyOf` is virtual and returns `codex`, and only `CustomCodexRuntime` overrides it. `DeepseekRuntime` (also a `CodexRuntime`, and registered by default) therefore files its refusals under `codex`, so a DeepSeek 'insufficient balance' refusal (a hopeless phrase) parks every Codex row with 'its Codex usage limit is spent', and a spent Codex quota parks DeepSeek rows in turn.

The locked write runs through `Task.Run(..., ct)` with the round's token. A round ended by its deadline or a stop therefore drops even parks that needed no probe (Claude, Codex, Kimi), and the log calls this 'the quota probe was cancelled', which is wrong. The plan only says that a cancelled probe parks nothing.
S33 checks the card's cooldown line against a date/time regex. The scenario asks for the exact S31 line.
S40 checks each edge-case verdict by the prefix of its record's `ToString()`, not by its type and value, so it asserts on text where behaviour is meant.
The cooldown file writes its instants with `ServerNotice.Iso` (milliseconds) but the wire and the sentence use a new `CooldownWords.Iso` (seconds), so one feature has two ISO formatters.
AGY_OLD is copied into a constant instead of being read from `fixtures/antigravity/consult-quota.stderr.txt`, which the plan names as its source. The bytes match today, but the copy can drift.

summary: All of the plan's decisions are built and wired, with build, format and both suites green, and 42 scenarios passing by exact name plus S14 under a recorded longer name. They include the structured verdict, the agy readers keyed by bucket id, the locked fail-open cooldown file, aggregation per key after the round, roster exclusion, the providers member and the card; the deviations are recorded honestly, and an extra test runs a real round end to end. The main flaw is that DeepSeek inherits Codex's `codex` quota key, so either vendor's spent quota can keep the other's rows out; the remaining findings are a cancellation edge and some text-based or duplicated test details.
